reason: This plugin is primarily a notification-style user interface enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web that surfaces session attention state to the user (waiting or done reminders) through a badge, tab title tag, and favicon indicator. Evidence in the README and package metadata limits behavior to client-side session-state visualization and state tracking, with no explicit external integrations or command execution features, so it is best classified as notifications/monitoring.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用于在会话等待你处理或完成未查看时，通过界面角标、浏览器标签前缀和图标颜色展示提醒，帮助你快速识别注意事项。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web shows attention reminders for session states by rendering a badge, tab title marker, and favicon cue when sessions are waiting or done.

capabilities: Displays session-attention status using in-browser UI elements (badge, tab title prefix, favicon color).
Tracks session state transitions from the web client session store to show waiting/completion reminders.
Supports session-reminder acknowledgement behavior to avoid repeatedly surfacing already-seen completions.

reasons.code: README states primary functionality is to show an attention badge in the frame, tab-title prefixes, and recolored favicon based on waiting/completed session state.
Package metadata declares a web platform client plugin (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`) with runtime injection and no terminal/file service permissions, indicating client-side-only operation.
Repository tree shows only plugin bundle, client, and patch/type files without additional service or background process assets.
